cell.label: Bacterial meningitis suspected. Immunocompromised, h/o CSF shunt, hydrocephalus, CNS mass, trauma, recent neurosurgery, papilledema, focal neuro deficit, or delay in LP? (Note: seizures and CN VI or VII palsy should not delay LP.)

Blood cultures and LPCBC with diff, CRP, CMP. Consider urine culture, latex agglutination. Consider PCR for viral causes. Empirical antimicrobial therapy immediately after CSF fluid obtained. Consider dexamethasone with first dose of antibiotics.
Review CSF results. Consistent with bacterial meningitis?
Assess risk for bacterial meningitis with Bacterial Meningitis Score Rule 277. Consider discharge with close follow-up if low risk.
